import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Find features with strong association (|t| > 5)
    t_stats = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] == 'clinical':
            continue  # Skip clinical features for this analysis
        x1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
        x0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
        t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(x1, x0, equal_var=False)
        t_stats.append(abs(t_stat))
    
    # Select top features by t-statistic
    top_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1][:10]
    top_fids = [feats.ids[i] for i in top_indices]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    keep_fids = []
    for fid in top_fids:
        if not keep_fids:
            keep_fids.append(fid)
        else:
            # Check correlation with existing kept features
            is_duplicate = False
            for kept_fid in keep_fids:
                col1 = feats.column(kept_fid)
                col2 = feats.column(fid)
                corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])[0, 1]
                if abs(corr) > 0.6:
                    is_duplicate = True
                    break
            if not is_duplicate:
                keep_fids.append(fid)
    
    # If no strong features found, return empty design
    if len(keep_fids) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Compute weighted score using mean differences
    loadings = {}
    for fid in keep_fids:
        col = feats.column(fid)
        x1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, col]
        x0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, col]
        mean_diff = np.mean(x1) - np.mean(x0)
        loadings[fid] = mean_diff
    
    # Normalize loadings
    total = sum(abs(w) for w in loadings.values())
    if total > 0:
        for fid in loadings:
            loadings[fid] /= total
    
    # Return module with strongest features as drivers
    sorted_by_loading = sorted(loadings.items(), key=lambda x: abs(x[1]), reverse=True)
    drivers = tuple(f[0] for f in sorted_by_loading[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    columns = tuple(keep_fids)
    products = ()
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
